articles.title: NFL to review additional abuse allegations against Packers star Josh Jacobs following May arrest
articles.summary: Since Josh Jacobs was arrested in May, several women have contacted police with abuse allegations against the Green Bay Packers running back.
articles.body: Since Josh Jacobs was arrested in May after an incident in which a woman claimed he threw her to the ground, records show several other women have come forward with allegations of their own against him. The other women's abuse allegations are detailed in records from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department first obtained by NBC 26. The documents also contain new details about the incident that led to the Green Bay Packers running back’s arrest in May. "We will review these allegations as part of the investigation which has remained open," the NFL told OutKick in a statement. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE One woman contacted police in June 2026 about an alleged incident involving Jacobs in January 2022. The woman told police that the allegations against Jacobs from the investigation into the May incident sounded similar to her experience with him, according to the records. The woman was not identified. The woman believed her alleged experience with Jacobs could be relevant to the May 2026 case, and she contacted police because she wanted people to believe the woman involved in the incident. The woman claimed she had communicated with Jacobs for about six months before spending around 11 hours at his home. The woman then alleged that after she told Jacobs she hadn’t come there for sex, he became angry, slapped her across the face and told her not to disrespect him. She said he allegedly took her phone and threw it into a swimming pool when she attempted to leave, and that he grabbed her by the hair, threw her onto a bed, pinned her down, threw her to the floor and said, "I should kill you right now." She said Jacobs also spit on her. The woman said she hadn’t previously reported the alleged incident to law enforcement because she remained friends with Jacobs afterward and was concerned her allegations wouldn’t be believed. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! Another woman told police she allegedly had sex with Jacobs in April 2021. The woman said his condom broke, so she told Jacobs to get tested for sexually transmitted diseases because they both had been involved with other people. The woman claimed Jacobs later removed her from the residence, grabbed her by the arms and bicep area, pushed her against a wall and threw her belongings out. She told police that she sustained bruises to her arms and swelling in her rib area. Hobart/Lawrence police said they obtained records from that incident indicating that officers observed "no visible signs of injury, bruising or damage consistent with a physical altercation." Another woman alleged she had met Jacobs through social media and that he flew her to a residence in May 2022. She described an alleged altercation in which Jacobs grabbed her by the hair, placed his hands on her head and neck, dragged her, scratched her chest and took her phone after it fell to the floor. The woman claimed she got bruises on her arm and scratches to her chest and neck. She said she didn’t report the incident to police because she wasn’t a U.S. citizen at the time and Jacobs told her she could be deported. SIGN UP FOR THE DAILY OUTKICK NEWSLETTER Jacobs' lawyers — David Z. Chesnoff, Richard A. Schonfeld and Clarence F. Duchac III — issued a statement Saturday on their client's behalf: "The Brown County District Attorney’s office had these uncorroborated, old, and previously unreported allegations for months. They conducted their own exhaustive investigation, along with the police department, and the D.A. determined that only two misdemeanor charges were warranted. They then entered into a plea agreement with Josh Jacobs. Josh has repeatedly expressed his remorse and is honoring the terms of the agreement." OutKick reached out to the Packers and Jacobs’ agent but did not immediately receive a response. The records released Friday also offered more details of the May 23 incident that led to Jacobs’ arrest. According to the criminal complaint released in August, the woman told them that Jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground as she was trying to exit a garage door, causing her to hit her head. Police said Jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground. The records released Friday noted the woman said that while they were still in the home, Jacobs lunged at her, pinned her on the bed with his body weight on her chest and put his hand on her mouth and nose, so that she felt she couldn’t breathe. She also indicated that she believed she lost consciousness for a brief time when the confrontation moved to the garage. Jacobs pleaded no contest last month to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property. He was removed from the list last week, but the NFL is still conducting its investigation. In his two games since returning to the 5-3 Packers, Jacobs has rushed 32 times for 75 yards and a touchdown, averaging just 2.3 yards per carry. The three-time Pro Bowler has been more productive as a receiver, catching 11 passes for 68 yards and two touchdowns. After scoring one of his touchdowns in the Packers’ 27-19 win over the Carolina Panthers on Thursday, Jacobs had a controversial touchdown celebration. He insisted he wasn’t making light of his recent arrest and that the celebration was instead inspired by a gospel song. The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.title: Cardinals' Budda Baker fields questions about trade rumors while wearing evil clown Halloween mask
articles.summary: Budda Baker showed up in a creepy clown costume for his media availability, then had to field Arizona Cardinals trade deadline questions in full getup.
articles.body: Today is Halloween, but Arizona Cardinals safety Budda Baker got into the spirit a day early, showing up to his media availability in costume. According to The New York Post, dressing up for Halloween is a tradition for Baker. However, this year’s costume created an awkward situation that highlights a workplace risk few people consider when dressing up for spooky season. Baker is one of the names floating around the rumor mill as the Cardinals trend toward becoming sellers at the NFL trade deadline. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE So, while Baker rolled in dressed in a creepy clown costume, the journalists there still had to ask him about the trade rumors. And to his credit, he answered them... while still in costume. "I just live in the present, like today, having a great time with you guys," Baker said. "Going to go out and have a great Friday practice, and just focus on playing against the Dallas Cowboys and trying to get a ‘W’ at their stadium." It's a good answer, but until you read it, did you have any idea what he was saying? Or, like me, were you distracted by the fact that he was dressed like a clown that drives a primered van and steals people's organs? People dress up for work on Halloween whether they're bank tellers or NFL players. However, I think we forget that it is still work, and sometimes you'll need to get serious. And if you're still in the costume, that can be tricky. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! If you're a doctor, it might seem like a good idea to dress like a Minion on Halloween. But what about when you have to deliver the news of someone's terminal diagnosis and the zipper is stuck? Suddenly, it's not as great of an idea, is it? I mean, maybe it'll have some kind of Patch Adams effect, but I doubt it. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Fortunately, an NFLer addressing trade rumors isn't that serious, so we all got a hilarious Halloween moment. Now, moving forward, I bet Baker will factor trade rumors and whether or not he'll have to address them into his costume choice.

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's charitable contribution of 70 million meals, 2.7 million winter coats and 8 million volunteer hours earns New York Cares' gratitude
articles.summary: In July, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce received a special message that put the spotlight on a meaningful part of their wedding celebrations.
articles.body: In July, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce received a special message that put the spotlight on a meaningful part of their wedding celebrations. Before getting married, the couple reportedly donated $26 million to charitable organisations across the United States. Among the beneficiaries was New York Cares, which recently shared a touching Instagram post expressing its gratitude. The organisation's message was more than a simple thank-you. It recognised how the couple had used an important milestone in their relationship to support people facing difficult circumstances, turning their pre-wedding generosity into something that could make a lasting difference.New York Cares shares emotional message for Taylor Swift and Travis KelceThe organisation shared a purple-themed appreciation card addressed directly to the newlyweds. Its message included a sweet reference to Swift's music, making the acknowledgement particularly special for the singer's fans.“Dear Taylor and Travis,We’re Enchanted to receive your generous gift to support New Yorkers in need.Thank you for making our mission a part of your Love Story.Best wishes,new york cares.”Alongside the graphic, New York Cares explained how the contribution would help strengthen its work across New York City. The organisation highlighted its efforts to address food insecurity, provide winter clothing and support children through essential resources.Its achievements include more than 70 million meals served, over eight million volunteer hours, 2.7 million winter coats distributed, more than 720,000 Winter Wishes granted to children and over 70,000 backpacks provided to students.For those unfamiliar with the organisation, New York Cares is a nonprofit that connects volunteers with community programmes across New York City. Its work focuses on supporting underserved communities through food distribution, education, winter assistance and other essential services.The organisation also encouraged Swift's supporters to take part in its charitable efforts, writing, "And to the Swifties who want to celebrate with us, we'd love to start your Giving Era."Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's $26 million donation supports charitiesNew York Cares was among more than a dozen organisations that publicly acknowledged the couple's pre-wedding contribution. Their reported $26 million donation reached charities in several cities with personal connections to Swift and Kelce, including Reading, Pennsylvania, Cleveland, Nashville and Kansas City.The Grammy Museum Foundation also thanked the couple for their "transformative gift", explaining that the contribution would help expand music education opportunities for students across the country.Kansas City's Harvesters food bank shared its own message of appreciation, writing, “We’d like to send a heartfelt thank you to @taylorswift and @killatrav for their very generous donation to our food bank just prior to their big wedding day. The two of them have incredibly big hearts and have shown up to support not only us but many charities over the years. We feel so lucky that they make the conscious effort to invest in hunger relief and the beautiful community we call Kansas City!”Dolly Parton also joined the list of well-wishers, thanking Swift and Kelce for their $2 million donation to her Imagination Library, which provides free books to children.While the couple's wedding attracted plenty of attention, their decision to support charitable causes before getting married gave the celebrations another dimension. New York Cares' message offered a reminder that their generosity reached far beyond their personal milestone.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Jonathan Taylor trade talks 'active and ongoing' as Colts now fielding calls on All-Pro running back: report
articles.summary: The Broncos, Packers, Vikings, Giants and Seahawks have all called about Jonathan Taylor as the Colts' NFL trade deadline fire sale heats up.
articles.body: It seems the Indianapolis Colts are indeed willing to talk about trading running back Jonathan Taylor after all. Multiple teams have reached out to the Colts amid their fire sale to see if Taylor is available, per ESPN and NFL Network. The talks "are said to be active and ongoing." Among those teams who have called the Colts and owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon are the Denver Broncos, Green Bay Packers, Minnesota Vikings, New York Giants and Seattle Seahawks. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE ESPN also reported that at least one offer included a second-round draft pick with additional compensation for Taylor. The Colts have already made it clear they would be sellers before the Nov. 10 NFL trade deadline following the firing of GM Chris Ballard after a 10-year stint with the franchise. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! Indianapolis traded Quenton Nelson, their All-Pro guard and former first-round pick, to the Seahawks. Defensive tackle DeForest Buckner also reunited with the San Francisco 49ers just hours after Nelson was dealt this past week. Wide receiver Josh Downs, who is in the final year of his rookie contract, also reportedly requested a trade. The Colts have reportedly told teams he’s worth a third-round pick, though they wish to keep him if possible despite the trade request. Taylor, on the other hand, has expressed his desire to stay put in Indianapolis, but he also understands that’s out of his control. The Colts made it clear they’re looking to accumulate draft picks amid a season where they’re 2-5 in the AFC South. Irsay-Gordon and Taylor reportedly met this week and had an "in-depth conversation to discuss the future," per ESPN. It is believed Irsay-Gordon would like Taylor to be a part of the Colts’ rebuild, though the franchise understands the type of return Taylor, who just signed a two-year extension before the start of this season, could have if dealt. The Colts have already secured a 2027 third- and fourth-round pick as well as a 2028 fifth-round selection from the Nelson and Buckner deals. Indianapolis is also without a 2027 first-round pick, which the New York Jets own after dealing Sauce Gardner to the Colts in 2025. Ahead of the Colts’ game against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday, Taylor addressed the trade rumors surrounding him. "I haven’t heard anything," he said on Thursday, per FOX59’s Mike Chappell. "I can’t control that, obviously. Like you guys know, I’m proud to wear the horseshoe, proud to be here. Similar to Quenton [Nelson] and [DeForest Buckner], they were proud to wear the horseshoe, they were proud to be here. But obviously, circumstances may cause otherwise. Hopefully that day may not come, but I can’t control that." Head coach Shane Steichen understands the business of the NFL like Taylor, which is why he’s trying to focus on this upcoming game and the players he has on the roster. It’s hard losing Nelson, a linchpin at left guard, and Buckner, a veteran leader on the defensive line, ahead of a key divisional matchup. But those are the cards Irsay-Gordon and the front office have been dealt, as they look ahead to building for the future instead of the remainder of the 2026 season.
